title: Umati Uliotoweka
intro: Unasimama mbele ya mwangwi wa jamii ambayo hadithi yake imeandikwa kwenye mawimbi. Nafsi hizi zilisikia wito, zikachagua uasi, na zikakabiliwa na matokeo yaliyobadilisha umbo la dunia. Wao ni akina nani, na nini kilitokea kwa ulimwengu wao?
clues: Tuliishi zamani sana, na mjumbe akatujia kutoka miongoni mwetu.
Tuliabudu sanamu tano na tukakataa kuziacha.
Tulimdhihaki mjumbe na kumtuhumu kwa kupotea.
Tulidai alete adhabu ikiwa alikuwa mkweli.
Tuliona mbingu zikimwagika mvua na ardhi ikibubujika chemchemi.
Tulipanda hadi sehemu za juu ili kutoroka, lakini mawimbi yalitupita.

outcome.label: Matokeo
options: Sote tuliangamia isipokuwa waumini pamoja na Nuh
outcome.answer: Sote tuliangamia isipokuwa waumini pamoja na Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
